what: Adding in NDCs from Product RxCUIs
title: Case Study: GLP1 receptor agonists
text: Now, let’s identify related NDCs RxCUI. Note RxCUIs link NDCs, NAs likely show resulting file. Voilà, now complete list GLP1-RAs can used query prescribing data pharmacy claims data.

title: Building route-specific RxCUI and NDC lists
text: common use case rxref develop list RxNorm product concepts National Drug Codes (NDCs) drug class. example, suppose want identify product RxCUIs active NDCs oral beta-blockers. simple searching beta-blocker ingredients mapping everything NDCs, beta-blockers available multiple routes. example: metoprolol, atenolol, labetalol, propranolol, sotalol may oral injectable products. esmolol injectable . timolol, betaxolol, related drugs may ophthalmic products. many pharmacoepidemiologic studies, may want oral outpatient-use products . vignette walks tidy workflow : resolving drug names ingredient RxCUIs; expanding ingredient RxCUIs product RxCUIs; filtering product RxCUIs route; , mapping filtered product RxCUIs active NDCs.

title: Building route-specific RxCUI and NDC lists
text: example, start generic drug names. future versions rxref, class-level helpers may make step automated. now, users can supply curated ingredient list class interest.
code: library(rxref) library(dplyr) library(purrr)  beta_blocker_names <- c(   "acebutolol",   "atenolol",   "betaxolol",   "bisoprolol",   "carvedilol",   "labetalol",   "metoprolol",   "nadolol",   "nebivolol",   "penbutolol",   "pindolol",   "propranolol",   "sotalol",   "timolol" )

what: Resolve drug names to ingredient RxCUIs
title: Building route-specific RxCUI and NDC lists
text: First, use find_ingredients() resolve drug name RxNorm ingredient concept. resulting table contains one row per resolved ingredient. ingredient RxCUIs starting point product expansion.
code: bb_ingredients <- find_ingredients(beta_blocker_names) |>   filter(tty == "IN") |>   distinct(     input,     ingredient_rxcui = rxcui,     ingredient_name = name   )  bb_ingredients

title: Building route-specific RxCUI and NDC lists
text: Next, use products_for_ingredients() identify product-level RxNorm concepts containing ingredient. default, returns product-level RxNorm concepts clinical drugs branded drugs. include_combos = TRUE, combination products retained. beta-blockers, means products beta-blocker/thiazide combinations may included. exclude combination products, set:
code: bb_products <- products_for_ingredients(   bb_ingredients$ingredient_rxcui,   include_combos = TRUE ) |>   left_join(bb_ingredients, by = "ingredient_rxcui")  bb_products bb_single_ingredient_products <- products_for_ingredients(   bb_ingredients$ingredient_rxcui,   include_combos = FALSE )  bb_single_ingredient_products

title: Building route-specific RxCUI and NDC lists
text: point, product list may include products multiple routes. example, beta-blockers oral tablets, injectable products, ophthalmic solutions. can use get_clinical_attributes() inspect route information product RxCUIs. helps verify whether product list includes routes outside intended use case.
code: bb_attrs <- get_clinical_attributes(   unique(bb_products$product_rxcui) )  bb_attrs |>   count(route, dose_form_group, sort = TRUE)

title: Building route-specific RxCUI and NDC lists
text: keep orally available products, use filter_products_by_route(). returned table keeps product-level metadata appends summarized route dose-form information. retain products oral tablets, capsules, oral solutions, excluding injectable ophthalmic products.
code: bb_oral_products <- bb_products |>   filter_products_by_route(route = "ORAL")  bb_oral_products bb_oral_products |>   count(routes, dose_form_groups, sort = TRUE)

what: Map oral product RxCUIs to active NDCs
title: Building route-specific RxCUI and NDC lists
text: product list restricted oral products, use map_rxcui_to_ndcs() map product RxCUIs NDCs. output flat tibble one row per product RxCUI/NDC pair. Product metadata retained alongside NDC.
code: bb_oral_ndcs <- map_rxcui_to_ndcs(   bb_oral_products,   status = "ACTIVE" )  bb_oral_ndcs bb_oral_ndcs |>   select(     ingredient_name,     product_rxcui,     product_name,     product_tty,     routes,     dose_forms,     ndc11,     ndc_status   )

title: Building route-specific RxCUI and NDC lists
text: quality control, useful summarize number products NDCs ingredient. may also want inspect combination products separately.
code: bb_oral_products |>   count(ingredient_name, sort = TRUE, name = "n_product_rxcuis")  bb_oral_ndcs |>   count(ingredient_name, sort = TRUE, name = "n_active_ndcs") bb_oral_products |>   filter(n_ingredients > 1) |>   select(     ingredient_name,     product_rxcui,     name,     tty,     n_ingredients,     routes,     dose_forms   )

title: Building route-specific RxCUI and NDC lists
text: workflow can run compactly search_drug(). return oral product RxCUIs : return flat table oral product RxCUIs active NDCs: direct workflow goal usable product RxCUI/NDC table.
code: bb_oral_rxcuis <- search_drug(   beta_blocker_names,   return = "rxcui",   route = "ORAL",   include_combos = TRUE )  bb_oral_rxcuis bb_oral_ndcs2 <- search_drug(   beta_blocker_names,   return = "ndc",   route = "ORAL",   ndc_status = "ACTIVE",   include_combos = TRUE )  bb_oral_ndcs2

what: Tidy Utilities for RxNorm and NDC Resolution
title: Tidy Utilities for RxNorm and NDC Resolution
text: rxref R package includes set tidy utilities querying National Library Medicine’s RxNorm API. RxNorm system normalized names clinical drugs well linkages names many drug vocabularies commonly used pharmacy management drug interaction software, including First Databank, Micromedex, Multum, Gold Standard Drug Database. rxref originally built facilitate pharmacoepidemiologic research UF CVmedLab, often need identify medication prescriptions pharmacy dispensings proxy medication exposure outcomes. core use case rxref identifying RxCUIs NDCs related user-supplied medications medication classes. package also includes helpers retrieving RxNorm properties, mapping RxCUIs NDCs, identifying ingredient concepts, filtering products route, querying selected RxClass relationships, working common RxNorm term type sets.

title: Tidy Utilities for RxNorm and NDC Resolution

code: # install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("ssmithm/rxref")

title: Tidy Utilities for RxNorm and NDC Resolution
text: basic example querying RxCUIs associated lisinopril (blood pressure-lowering drug):
code: library(rxref) lisinopril.ing <- find_ingredients('lisinopril') lisinopril.ing |> knitr::kable() lisinopril.rxcuis <- products_for_ingredients(lisinopril.ing$rxcui, ttys = c("SCD", "SBD"), include_combos = TRUE)  # Resulting table of all related products with TTY in {SCD, SBD} lisinopril.rxcuis |>    dplyr::mutate(name = paste0("`", name, "`")) |>    knitr::kable() # Count of TTYs in resulting table aggregate(   x = list(count = rep(1, nrow(lisinopril.rxcuis))),    by = list(tty = lisinopril.rxcuis$tty),    FUN = sum ) |> knitr::kable()

what: Get class-like RxClass assertions for RxNorm drugs — get_drug_classes
title: Get class-like RxClass assertions for RxNorm drugs — get_drug_classes
text: get_drug_classes() experimental convenience function returns RxClass assertions likely behave like drug-class labels. combines selected assertions ATC, ATCPROD, FDA/SPL EPC, VA, SNOMED CT disposition relationships. intentionally excludes relationship types usually describe contraindications, indications, physiologic effects, chemical structures, non-class assertions. compact ingredient-oriented output, rely defaults include_sources. extended list product-level sources, consider adding "ATCPROD" "VA". function experimental "drug class" single native RxClass concept. Different sources use different classification logic, helper applies opinionated filter return class-like assertions. source-specific results, use get_classes(), get_atc(), get_epc(), get_va(), related functions directly.

title: rxref: Tidy RxNorm utilities — rxref-package
text: rxref provides tidy, API-first tools working RxNorm RxClass data R. package helps users resolve drug names identifiers, inspect RxNorm concepts, map RxCUIs NDCs, expand ingredients product-level concepts, retrieve drug class information, derive clinically useful product attributes.

title: rxref: Tidy RxNorm utilities — rxref-package
text: Common workflows include: Resolving drug names identifiers resolve() search_drug(). Retrieving concept metadata get_properties(). Building product-level medication lists find_ingredients(), ingredients_for_rxcui(), products_for_ingredients(). Mapping RxCUIs NDCs map_to(), map_ndc_to_rxcui(), map_rxcui_to_ndc(). Retrieving therapeutic class information get_classes(), find_classes(), get_class_members(), get_atc(), get_epc(), get_va(). Deriving clinical product attributes get_clinical_attributes() filter_products_by_route(). Configure package behavior rxref_conf().
